definition:
flowchart LR
  Start([Request]) --> Auth[Authenticate]
  Auth --> Cache{Cache hit?}
  Cache -->|hit| Serve[Serve cached]
  Cache -->|miss| Fetch[Fetch from origin]
  Fetch --> Store[(Write cache)]
  Store --> Serve
  Serve --> Done([Response])
  classDef deep fill:#0b3d2e,stroke:#0b3d2e,stroke-width:2px
  classDef mid fill:#8b0000,stroke:#8b0000,stroke-width:2px
  class Start,Auth,Cache,Serve deep
  class Fetch,Store,Done mid
intent: TEXT DRAWN ON A COLORED ELEMENT with NO text color specified - same graph as w3-09/w3-10/w3-15, dark saturated fills (#0b3d2e forest, #8b0000 maroon) and no color: property, so the label color is whatever the THEME supplies. In light theme the theme's text is dark (#333-ish) and will be near-invisible on these fills; in dark theme the theme's text is #eceff4 and should be fine. That asymmetry is the whole point: the fill is user-controlled and the text is theme-controlled, and nothing reconciles them. Both candidate pairs are computable.
